candidates.particulars: Name: Grace Minseo Han. Age: 29. Gender: female. Nationality: American. Race/ethnicity: Asian, specifically Korean American. Residence: Seattle, Washington. Gross household income: $128,000 annually; she lives alone and this is her household's income. Partnership status: single and currently unpartnered. Children status: has no children. Political identification: Libertarian, prioritizing individual liberty and skeptical of government restrictions in both social and economic life. Reading interest: enjoys reading for leisure and personal interest, especially contemporary fiction and essays.
candidates.life_course: Grace grew up in eastern Washington and moved west for college, where she studied visual communication. She now works as a product designer at a mid-sized software company. Her work is steady, but she has changed teams and employers enough to know that she likes autonomy more than a prestigious title. After sharing apartments with friends, she chose a small place of her own; her income lets her save regularly while managing rent and ordinary expenses. She is close to her parents and younger brother, though they live elsewhere.
candidates.daily_life: Most weekdays combine focused computer work, a walk or short workout, and an uncomplicated dinner. She sees a couple of friends for coffee, dinner, or a film, and keeps some evenings deliberately unbooked. Reading is a reliable way to wind down; she borrows books as well as buying ones she expects to revisit. She occasionally attends local design or arts events but doesn't build her social life around work.
candidates.travel: Grace likes trips that mix a walkable neighborhood, good meals, and time to explore without a packed itinerary. She often travels with one friend, but is comfortable taking a solo weekend when schedules don't align. With paid time off and savings, she can manage a longer trip some years and shorter regional breaks in others. She once took a few days on the Oregon coast with a friend, choosing a modest guesthouse and leaving open space for walks and reading. She would consider a larger international trip for art, food, and city wandering, but has no destination or booking set for her next vacation.
candidates.personality_and_voice: She tends to be observant and practical, and likes having room to revise a plan rather than treating an itinerary as a contract. In conversation she is warm but not especially ceremonious; she asks specific questions when something is unclear. She enjoys recommending a book or café, but doesn't assume other people share her tastes. When weighing a choice, she usually wants enough information to decide for herself.

candidates.particulars: Name: Grace Minseo Han. Age: 36. Gender: female. Nationality: American. Race/ethnicity: Asian, specifically Korean American. Residence: Portland, Oregon. Gross household income: $164,000 annually, combined with her adult sister, with whom she shares a home. Partnership status: single and currently unpartnered. Children status: has no children. Political identification: Libertarian, prioritizing individual liberty and skeptical of government restrictions in both social and economic life. Reading interest: enjoys reading for leisure and personal interest, including history, memoir, and mysteries.
candidates.life_course: Grace studied communications at a public university and started in nonprofit communications before moving into independent research and writing projects for small businesses. She now has a mix of recurring clients, which gives her some control over her hours but makes her careful about keeping a financial cushion. She shares a house with her sister, a practical arrangement they chose for companionship and shared costs rather than out of necessity alone. Grace has dated, but is not currently in a relationship and has no children.
candidates.daily_life: She usually starts work at home, takes a midday break outside, and reserves a few blocks each week for errands, exercise, and client calls. She and her sister cook together sometimes, while other evenings they each do their own thing. Grace keeps in touch with former coworkers and a small group of friends through dinners, board games, and occasional live performances. She reads before bed or listens to a book while doing routine chores.
candidates.travel: Grace is drawn to trips with a cultural or historical thread: museums, neighborhood walks, bookshops, and meals that aren't rushed. She enjoys traveling with her sister, but also takes occasional solo trips when their calendars differ. Her flexible client work can make a midweek departure possible, though she avoids being away during important project deadlines and sets money aside between trips. She once went to Chicago with a friend, spending much of the visit walking through different neighborhoods and visiting museums rather than trying to see everything. She would like to visit South Korea someday, partly to experience the country beyond family stories, but hasn't chosen dates or made arrangements.
candidates.personality_and_voice: Grace is conversational and curious, with a habit of asking how a place or tradition came to be. She enjoys spontaneity once basic logistics are settled, but dislikes being hurried from one attraction to another. When discussing plans, she is candid about what she can commit to and comfortable saying that she needs time to think. Her humor is dry and usually self-directed.

candidates.particulars: Name: Grace Minseo Han. Age: 45. Gender: female. Nationality: American. Race/ethnicity: Asian, specifically Korean American. Residence: Sacramento, California. Gross household income: $142,000 annually, shared with her widowed mother, who lives in the same household. Partnership status: single and currently unpartnered. Children status: has no children. Political identification: Libertarian, prioritizing individual liberty and skeptical of government restrictions in both social and economic life. Reading interest: enjoys reading for leisure and personal interest, particularly literary fiction and biographies.
candidates.life_course: Grace studied supply-chain management and has spent most of her career coordinating inventory and logistics for private-sector companies. She is experienced enough to work independently but still values a dependable team. A few years ago, her mother moved in after a period of living alone; they share household costs and routines, and Grace helps with some practical errands. That arrangement shapes her time without defining their relationship: her mother is independent, and Grace maintains her own friendships and interests. Grace is single, has no children, and has built a life that does not depend on a partner's schedule.
candidates.daily_life: Her workdays begin early, with a quick review of messages and a commute to the office. After work she might prepare dinner with her mother, meet a friend, or take a quiet evening with a novel. She has a regular walking habit and likes occasional classes or community events when her workload permits. Weekends often include a shared household errand, but she protects some time for herself and keeps up with friends from work and college.
candidates.travel: Grace prefers comfortable, unhurried travel over a checklist of sights. She enjoys trips with a longtime friend and sometimes travels with her mother when the itinerary can be paced gently; she also values a day or two alone within a longer visit. Her paid leave and savings make a substantial trip possible now and then, while short drives or overnight stays are easier to fit around work and family routines. She once spent a few days in Monterey with a friend, taking walks, visiting local attractions, and leaving afternoons open rather than booking every hour. She is interested in future trips that combine coastal scenery with museums or local history, but hasn't decided where or when to go next.
candidates.personality_and_voice: Grace is steady and thoughtful, and often considers how a decision will affect the people sharing her household. She is not afraid to set a boundary, though she prefers to do so plainly rather than make a confrontation of it. She notices useful details and can be quietly funny. In conversation she gives measured answers, then becomes animated when discussing a book, a trip, or a well-organized system.

candidates.particulars: Name: Grace Minseo Han. Age: 53. Gender: female. Nationality: American. Race/ethnicity: Asian, specifically Korean American. Residence: Anchorage, Alaska. Gross household income: $118,000 annually; she lives alone and this is her household's income. Partnership status: single and currently unpartnered. Children status: has no children. Political identification: Libertarian, prioritizing individual liberty and skeptical of government restrictions in both social and economic life. Reading interest: enjoys reading for leisure and personal interest, including nature writing, novels, and practical nonfiction.
candidates.life_course: Grace was raised in Alaska in a family that moved there when she was young. She trained in business administration and has worked in operations for private companies, most recently coordinating schedules, records, and purchasing for a construction supplier. She knows the work well and appreciates its tangible demands, though she sometimes considers taking on fewer hours later in life. She has been single for several years and has no children. Her close relationships are spread between Anchorage, other parts of Alaska, and relatives in the Lower 48.
candidates.daily_life: Grace's routine shifts with daylight and work demands: she handles office tasks, keeps a few household projects moving, and gets outside when conditions and energy allow. She enjoys a small circle of friends, including occasional shared meals and walks, but is comfortable spending a quiet evening by herself. She reads in short stretches and keeps a stack of books near her favorite chair. Phone calls with relatives are a regular part of staying connected, particularly when travel isn't practical.
candidates.travel: Grace values travel that feels different from ordinary routines: a change of landscape, local food, and enough unscheduled time to settle into a place. She can travel solo and likes not having to negotiate every stop, but would also enjoy a longer trip with a friend or relative. Work leave and household savings let her plan ahead for major travel, while weather, distance, and responsibilities at work make spontaneous long journeys less appealing. She once chose a trip to the Pacific Northwest with a friend, combining time in a city with a few quieter days near the coast. She is curious about visiting South Korea and would also like to see more of the western United States; she has not settled on her next destination or made a booking.
candidates.personality_and_voice: Grace is self-reliant and direct, though not in a hurry to dominate a conversation. She likes clear practical information and has little patience for being pressured into a decision. Her stories often include small observations about weather, people, or how a place felt rather than a list of accomplishments. She can be reserved with strangers and lively with people she trusts.
